subject: Pilot playbook kickoff — draft timeline, owners, and asks (ClearSight Health)
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: janet.cole@clearsighthealth.com, buyers@clearsighthealth.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot playbook kickoff — draft timeline, owners, and asks (ClearSight Health)

Hi Janet / ClearSight team,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — good clarity on use cases and success criteria. As promised, I attached a first-pass pilot playbook (MAP-style) that lays out milestones, proposed owners, and dependencies. Please see the key items below and the attached spreadsheet (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx).

Quick recap (from call):
- Goal: Proof-of-value pilot to validate summarization + clinical extraction on a 10k encounter sample.
- Primary success metrics: extraction accuracy >= 85% on key fields, end-to-end latency under 400ms per request at 95th percentile, and cost < $0.12 / 1k tokens for steady-state inference.

Draft milestones (high level):
1) Kickoff & stakeholder alignment — confirm owners, legal/compliance reviewers (this email). Target: week 1
2) Technical workshop & sample data exchange — SRE + SE validation, sandbox access. Target: week 2
3) Integration & test harness — ingest sample dataset, run baseline evals. Target: weeks 3–4
4) Pilot run & metrics review — 2-week run, quality/cost check. Target: weeks 5–6
5) Decision & next steps — expand to 6-month deployment or iterate on scope. Target: week 7

Two timeline options (pick one):
- Option A (aggressive): 6–7 weeks to decision — fast track if ClearSight can share sample data and IT can approve sandbox access within 5 business days.
- Option B (conservative): 10–11 weeks — accounts for legal review, procurement timelines, and an optional security questionnaire cycle.

Proposed owners (we can adjust):
- Redwood: laura_bennett (engagement lead), aditya_rao (solutions SE), monica_patel (CS ops)
- ClearSight: Janet Cole (product owner), technical contact (TBD), legal/compliance (TBD)

Dependencies / blockers we called out:
- Security questionnaire completion (SOC2 evidence)
- Sample dataset access (de-identified) for benchmark runs
- Procurement/PO or standard MSA acceptance for pilot
Ask: Please confirm the following by end of week:
1) Preferred timeline (Option A vs Option B)
2) List of internal stakeholders we should include on the playbook (technical contact + legal reviewer)
3) Whether ClearSight can provide the sample dataset (or a test S3 link) by May 24 so we can schedule the technical workshop the week of May 24–28.

Attachments included: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (playbook), discovery-notes.pdf (call notes)

If that all looks good, I’ll update the spreadsheet with confirmed owners and send an invite for the technical workshop.

Thanks,

--
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 17:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Pilot playbook kickoff — draft timeline, owners, and asks (ClearSight Health)

Laura — thanks for the clear recap and the draft. A few notes from our side:

1) Timeline: we prefer Option B (conservative 10–11 week) because our legal and procurement teams typically need two full weeks for any MSA/PO review. That said, we want to move quickly on the technical side.

2) Stakeholders to add:
   - Samir Patel (Legal) <samir.patel@clearsighthealth.com> — please loop in for the contract side
   - Omar Ruiz (IT/Security) <omar.ruiz@clearsighthealth.com> — will own sandbox access and data approvals
   - Myself (Janet Cole) — product owner
3) Data: We can provide a de-identified 10k-encounter sample. IT needs a one-page tech brief before granting access; can Redwood share a short S3 access requirements doc?

4) Workshop: Week of May 24 works for us for a technical workshop. Can you do Tuesday or Wednesday morning (ET)?

I’ve copied Samir and Omar on a separate note (cc withheld in this thread for privacy). Once you share the brief, IT will expedite.

Thanks,

Janet Cole
Director of Product
ClearSight Health
janet.cole@clearsighthealth.com
From: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, janet.cole@clearsighthealth.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot playbook kickoff — draft timeline, owners, and asks (ClearSight Health)

Thanks Janet — great. Laura, looping in a proposed tech workshop agenda and a one-page S3 access requirements brief (attached: workshop-agenda-v1.pdf).

Proposed 90-minute workshop outline:
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives (Laura / Janet)
- 10–30m: Redwood architecture overview + security posture for private data handling (Aditya)
- 30–50m: Data schema and required de-identification checklist (joint)
- 50–80m: Live run of a small sample in sandbox (if IT has already granted access) or dry-run with synthetic data
- 80–90m: Next steps & action items (owners / dates)

Pre-reqs from ClearSight for the workshop:
- Provide a 10–100 row sample (CSV) ahead of the call OR grant S3 read-only access to the de-identified bucket
- Identify Omar Ruiz as the technical contact for IT/sandbox approvals
If IT prefers, we can run the live demo with synthetic data and then swap in the real sample once access is granted.

I’ll be available Tuesday May 25 at 10:00am ET if that works — otherwise Wednesday May 26 at 09:30am ET.
--
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot playbook kickoff — draft timeline, owners, and asks (ClearSight Health)

Janet — appreciate the quick confirmation and the stakeholder names. I updated the attached playbook and set the target decision date to July 12, 2027 (this aligns with Option B / ~10-week path). See the changes in the spreadsheet: we added Samir (legal) and Omar (IT) as dependencies; responsibilities column also shows who will own each milestone.

Next concrete steps (action owners):
- ClearSight: confirm Omar for IT sandbox approval and send either a 10–100 row sample or S3 details (Janet / Omar) — due May 21
- Redwood: send final S3 access requirements and security brief (Aditya) — done (attached)
- Redwood: send calendar invite for the tech workshop (Laura) — pending until we confirm Tuesday/Wednesday availability
- Procurement/legal: Samir to review MSA template; we can provide a redlined MSA if preferred (Karthik will coordinate)

I’ll hold Tuesday May 25 10:00am ET on my calendar and send a calendar invite once you confirm. If May 25 is no good, May 26 09:30am ET is our backup.

Thanks team — looking forward to the kick-off.

Best,
